about: The multilingual set, added after the steward review asked for wider language coverage and inflection handling. Fourteen cases in eight more target languages (French, Arabic, Japanese, Chinese, Russian, Turkish, Italian, Portuguese), each a real sentence about Faithful itself, each varying one thing. M7 and M9 test inflection of glossary terms (a kept term with a Turkish suffix, a Portuguese plural of a rendering), the point the review raised; M8 is the complement (the kept term kept). M3 and M10 test that number formatting follows the target language, M11 that a value change is still caught, M12 that a heading level change is caught. Written and locked before the first run; every verdict is published as it comes out.

cases.title: French, faithful two-sentence warning
cases.source: Never share your recovery phrase. Anyone who has it can move your funds.
cases.translation: Ne partagez jamais votre phrase de récupération. Toute personne qui la possède peut déplacer vos fonds.
cases.why: Meaning, force and glossary rendering kept

cases.title: French, the same warning softened and its second sentence dropped

cases.translation: Il vaut mieux ne pas partager votre phrase de récupération.

cases.title: Arabic, faithful, with Arabic-Indic digits
